Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 90. Category: form. Red Eye.

Power-Up
You have learned to actively harness your hyper-
evolved eye. Your view is now slightly telescopic
allowing you to aim and even snipe with your energy
attacks.
Increase your Power by 2
You gain a +1 to all Wisdom (Perception) checks
The range of all Standard Ki Attacks and Ki
Techniques increase by 25% (1/4)
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
Gained at Level 5
